name: QQQ Initial Balance Analysis - Prior Day Low Break
description: Research study analyzing QQQ daily bars to identify when price breaks below the prior day's low, and measures where the close finishes relative to the day's midpoint. Calculates statistics and probabilities of recovery behavior.
source:
# QQQ Initial Balance Analysis - Prior Day Low Break
# Analyzes daily bars to identify when price breaks below prior day's low
# and measures where the close finishes relative to the day's midpoint

# Data source - Daily bars
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# Get prior day's low using lag operator
prior_day_low = low >> 1

# Detect when today's low breaks below prior day's low
low_break = low < prior_day_low

# Calculate day's midpoint
midpoint = (high + low) / 2

# Calculate close position in range (0 = at low, 1 = at high, 0.5 = at midpoint)
day_range = high - low
close_position = (close - low) / day_range

# Determine if close is in upper half of range
upper_half = close_position > 0.5

# Create filtered metrics for break days only
break_count = 1.0 if low_break else 0.0
upper_half_on_break = 1.0 if (low_break and upper_half) else 0.0
close_pos_on_break = where(low_break, close_position)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Prior Day Low Break Statistics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Total Days with Break", card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info="Count of days where low was below prior day's low"),
            ColumnSpec(title="Upper Half Recovery %", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info="Percentage of break days that closed in upper half of range"),
            ColumnSpec(title="Average Close Position", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, info="Mean position of close within the day's range (0=low, 1=high, 0.5=midpoint)")
        ]
    ),
    category="Statistics"
)(break_count, upper_half_on_break, close_pos_on_break)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLES
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="All Occurrences",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Prior Day Low", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Today Low", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Today High", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Midpoint", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Position", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Upper Half", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    ),
    category="Data"
)(prior_day_low, low, high, close, midpoint, close_position, upper_half, low_break)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS
# =============================================================================

histogram(
    title="Distribution of Close Position",
    category="Charts",
    bins=20,
    x_axis_label="Close Position in Range",
    y_axis_label="Frequency",
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_color=Color.Blue
)(close_pos_on_break)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Prior Day Low Break",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Prior Day Low", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Today Low", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close Position", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Upper Half", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(prior_day_low, low, close_position, upper_half, low_break)
